title: Reimagining Peer Review Process Through Multi-Agent Mechanism Design
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE/ACM 48th International Conference on Software Engineering: Future of Software Engineering (ICSE-FoSE). 4 pages, 1 figure, 1 table
summary: The software engineering research community faces a systemic crisis: peer review is failing under growing submissions, misaligned incentives, and reviewer fatigue. Community surveys reveal that researchers perceive the process as "broken." This position paper argues that these dysfunctions are mechanism design failures amenable to computational solutions. We propose modeling the research community as a stochastic multi-agent system and applying multi-agent reinforcement learning to design incentive-compatible protocols. We outline three interventions: a credit-based submission economy, MARL-optimized reviewer assignment, and hybrid verification of review consistency. We present threat models, equity considerations, and phased pilot metrics. This vision charts a research agenda toward sustainable peer review.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文（position paper），主张把同行评审危机视为"机制设计失败"而非道德问题，将研究社区建模为随机多智能体系统，用多智能体强化学习（MARL）设计激励相容的评审协议，提出三大支柱：基于"评审信用（Review Credit）"的投稿经济、CMARL 优化的审稿人分配、以及结构化清单+论证框架+LLM"代理评审"（Agent-as-a-Judge）的混合一致性验证；并给出威胁模型、公平性考量与分阶段（2025–2029）试点路线图（RCT、影子模式、联邦化）。
AI.motivation: 软件工程研究社区的同行评审在投稿量激增（约2016–2022年发表量增长47%）、激励错位（"发表或灭亡"文化使评审几乎零收益）与审稿人疲劳下系统性失灵，社区调查普遍认为评审"已崩坏"。作者引用的证据包括：NeurIPS 2014 重复评审一致性实验显示两个委员会对同一论文结果不一致率达57%；6.5%–16.9%的AI会议评审存在实质性LLM参与；LLM代理模拟实验中最高37.1%的决策方差可归因于建模的审稿人偏见。这构成"评审公地悲剧"：审稿注意力预算有限、耗竭成本外部化，编辑邀请接受率下降，导致仓促评审与"审稿轮盘"。传统回应视其为需文化变革的社会问题，本文主张其本质是可工程化的机制设计问题。
AI.method: （1）形式化建模：研究社区被建模为随机多智能体系统⟨A, S, T, R⟩，当前R_rev≈0而R_pub>0，目标是通过重塑奖励使高质量评审成为个体理性行为。（2）信用经济：投稿消耗RC、质量评审赚取RC；价格闭环更新规则p_{t+1}=p_t+γ(D_t−S_t)并截断到[p_min,p_max]，按月度epoch带自适应阻尼；信用流速V=总交易额/总供给作为稳定性指标，采用Lyapunov控制策略调节发行率，低于安全阈值时由中心储备临时补贴以防通缩螺旋；发放上限与过期机制抑制囤积；质量由盲评作者评分、元审稿人一致性与具体性度量多信号合成，并优先评估信息论评分（peer prediction变体）；新人初始禀赋、困难豁免、带指导的信用获取通道；账本由会议集中托管，程序主席仲裁并可升级至常设伦理委员会，撤销需有书面不当行为证据并提供申诉权。（3）CMARL分配：状态含审稿负载、历史迟交、近期拒审模式与主题嵌入距离；动作为受硬约束（COI、最大负载）的分配矩阵；奖励为及时性、具体性与公平性惩罚的多目标函数；针对离线RL的混淆问题，训练期使用双重稳健估计量或因果 bandit 评估反事实分配；并给出可接受学习复杂度的判据（如及时性提升>10%）。（4）混合验证：结构化清单+论证框架抽取评审中的主张，LLM验证器检查立场与论文内容一致性；针对偏差与Goodhart效应，随机抽取10%由人工复核做校准，未来可结合密码水印/溯源证明；目标每篇评审额外开销<5分钟。（5）实验路线：Phase 0 基于OpenReview历史数据构建ABM仿真校准γ并压力测试合谋圈、搭便车等策略行为，同时部署轻量干预（审稿人认证、双向反馈、结构化模板）建立基线；Phase 1 在ICSE workshop以"程序委员会区域"为随机化单位做RCT，功效分析检测0.5σ及时性变化（α=0.05），指标含完成率>90%、信用基尼系数<0.3、新人参与度；Phase 2 影子模式对比ILP基线，指标及时性>10%改善、负载均衡与群体公平；Phase 3 混合验证部署并向联合会议与主会场扩展，跨会议联邦需SIG协调并制定反套利政策；治理层面设日落条款、退出通道、透明审计报告与年度评估。
AI.result: 本文为立场/愿景论文，不给出实证结果，而是提供了系统性的设计框架：三层闭环架构（信用经济 ↔ MARL分配 ↔ 混合验证，其中验证质量反馈直接影响信用发放与价格动态）、覆盖三大组件与跨组件的威胁—缓解对照表（评审圈套→网络分析+随机审计；信用囤积→过期与上限；质量作弊→多信号评分与离群检测；偏见放大→公平约束与离线评估；战略性拒审→将拒审模式纳入分配权重；LLM代写评审→披露要求与具体性评分；浅评→论证覆盖度与人工分诊；女巫攻击→ORCID+机构验证；报复→盲评与时间平滑），并提出按地区、机构类型、职业阶段分解的信用基尼系数等公平度量，以及隐私保护型证明以兼顾审计与匿名。文中明确声明所提机制"尚非已验证方案"，需ABM仿真与均衡分析先行验证。
AI.conclusion: 同行评审危机的根源是激励错位而非道德失败；通过把治理问题当作工程问题加以形式化，机制设计可使高质量评审行为成为个体理性选择。作者给出三大干预支柱（信用经济、MARL分配、混合验证）并配套分阶段研究议程、威胁模型、公平与隐私考量以及治理可持续性建议（承认评审贡献、日落条款、退出机制、透明审计），邀请评审社区共同推进这一研究议程。主要局限与风险包括信用体系可能被博弈（review ring、囤积、质量作弊）、学习型分配可能放大既有偏见、LLM验证存在偏差与Goodhart风险并带来额外开销；缓解路径依赖仿真校准、RCT/影子模式验证与人工在环审计。

title: Accelerating Large-Scale Cheminformatics Using a Byte-Offset Indexing Architecture for Terabyte-Scale Data Integration
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 5 equations, 3 algorithms, 4 tables, to be published in ICoICT 2026, unabridged version exists as arXiv:2512.24643v1
summary: The integration of large-scale chemical databases represents a critical bottleneck in modern cheminformatics research, particularly for machine learning applications requiring high-quality, multi-source validated datasets. This paper presents a case study of integrating three major public chemical repositories: PubChem (176 million compounds), ChEMBL, and eMolecules, to construct a curated dataset for molecular property prediction. We investigate whether byte-offset indexing can practically overcome brute-force scalability limits while preserving data integrity at hundred-million scale. Our results document the progression from an intractable brute-force search algorithm with projected 100-day runtime to a byte-offset indexing architecture achieving 3.2-hour completion-a 740-fold performance improvement through algorithmic complexity reduction from O(NxM) to O(N+M). Systematic validation of 176 million database entries revealed hash collisions in InChIKey molecular identifiers, necessitating pipeline reconstruction using collision-free full InChI strings. We present performance benchmarks, quantify trade-offs between storage overhead and scientific rigor, and compare our approach with alternative large-scale integration strategies. The resulting system successfully extracted 435,413 validated compounds and demonstrates generalizable principles for large-scale scientific data integration where uniqueness constraints exceed hash-based identifier capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文以 PubChem（1.76 亿化合物）、ChEMBL 与 eMolecules 三大公共化学数据库的集成为案例，构建面向分子性质预测的高质量数据集。核心工作是将不可行的暴力检索（预计 100 天）重构为字节偏移索引架构，仅 3.2 小时完成，740 倍加速（复杂度由 O(N×M) 降至 O(N+M)）；在对 1.76 亿条记录的系统校验中发现 InChIKey 哈希碰撞问题，管道因此改用无碰撞的完整 InChI 字符串重建。最终提取出 435,413 个经校验的化合物，并总结了当唯一性约束超出哈希标识符能力时的通用工程原则。
AI.motivation: 现代化学信息学尤其是机器学习应用严重依赖高质量、多来源交叉验证的大型数据集，而大规模公共化学数据库的整合是公认瓶颈。已有做法多采用暴力比对或受限于哈希标识符的方案，在亿级规模下既无法在合理时间内完成，又面临标识符唯一性不受保证的风险。因此需要：1）一种在亿级规模下仍可实用的记录匹配与对齐算法；2）对主流标识符（InChIKey）在全库尺度下碰撞率的实证评估；3）在存储开销与科学严谨性之间做明确权衡的可复现管线。
AI.method: 1）集成框架：对 PubChem（1.76 亿）、ChEMBL、eMolecules 三个公共库做统一 schema 的条目抽取与记录对齐；2）算法重构：放弃逐对两两比较的暴力搜索（O(N×M)），改为基于字节偏移（byte-offset）的索引架构，将匹配过程分解为建索引与查表两个 O(N)、O(M) 阶段，从而支持对整个库的直接随机访问；3）标识符验证：对 1.76 亿条记录做系统性唯一性校验，统计 InChIKey 作为哈希键的碰撞情况，并据此将管线改为使用完整 InChI 字符串作为无碰撞主键进行重建；4）性能基准与权衡量化：测量运行时长、存储开销，比较与替代大规模整合策略（如数据库 join、格式转换后 SQL 导入、分布式处理等）的差异；5）输出：经校验的 435,413 个化合物数据集用于下游分子性质预测。
AI.result: 字节偏移索引方案在 3.2 小时内完成全量整合，相对预计 100 天的暴力搜索实现约 740 倍加速，复杂度从 O(N×M) 降至 O(N+M)，且在亿级规模下保持数据完整性。对 1.76 亿条目的验证确认 InChIKey 确实存在哈希碰撞，表明仅以其为唯一键会静默污染数据集，改用完整 InChI 字符串可彻底规避。最终提取 435,413 个通过校验的化合物；实验同时量化了索引带来的存储膨胀代价与科学严谨性收益，并给出与替代整合方案的对比。
AI.conclusion: 在大规模科学数据整合中，算法复杂度降级（从笛卡尔积式两两比较转为线性建索引+查表）可带来数量级的工程收益，使亿级跨库整合从理论可行变为实践可行（100 天 → 3.2 小时）。同时，哈希型分子标识符在真实全库尺度下不能被默认视为唯一，InChIKey 的碰撞必须被显式检测并以完整 InChI 替代，否则下游机器学习会继承被污染的标签。论文提出的案例表明：对于唯一性约束超出哈希标识符能力的大规模数据整合任务，正确的架构选择（索引 + 无碰撞主键）比单纯增加算力更能提升可扩展性与结果可靠性，并具备可推广的原则性意义。

title: Trustworthy Scheduling for Big Data Applications
summary: Recent advances in modern containerized execution environments have resulted in substantial benefits in terms of elasticity and more efficient utilization of computing resources. Although existing schedulers strive to optimize performance metrics like task execution times and resource utilization, they provide limited transparency into their decision-making processes or the specific actions developers must take to meet Service Level Objectives (SLOs). In this work, we propose X-Sched, a middleware that uses explainability techniques to generate actionable guidance on resource configurations that makes task execution in containerized environments feasible, under resource and time constraints. X-Sched addresses this gap by integrating counterfactual explanations with advanced machine learning models, such as Random Forests, to efficiently identify optimal configurations. This approach not only ensures that tasks are executed in line with performance goals but also gives users clear, actionable insights into the rationale behind scheduling decisions. Our experimental results validated with data from real-world execution environments, illustrate the efficiency, benefits and practicality of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可解释的容器化大数据任务调度中间件 X-Sched，将反事实解释与随机森林分类器结合，在资源与截止时间（SLO）约束下为不可调度的任务生成最小化、可执行、多样的容器资源配置建议，并配套实现了支持分布式训练原语的 X-Sched 库。实验基于阿里巴巴生产集群 24 小时真实轨迹数据，在本地 8 节点集群上验证了生成解的可行性与密度。
AI.motivation: 云原生容器化环境（Kubernetes、Docker Swarm、Mesos）虽提升了弹性与资源利用率，但资源规格（CPU、内存、副本数）的选型仍完全依赖从业者手工试验，存在过配/欠配问题。现有方法——无论是基于 ILP + GridSearch/SMBO 的最优配置求解，还是基于贝叶斯优化/深度强化学习的策略学习——本质上都是黑盒：既无法解释决策依据，也不能给出替代配置建议，更无法在任务因约束而调度失败时主动给出补救动作（如 AWS Compute Optimizer 仅覆盖部分 EC2 实例族、依赖 CloudWatch Agent 且受历史时间窗限制）。同时，任务负载动态波动与流水线/DAG 依赖使得穷举所有配置既耗时又昂贵。作者进一步指出可解释性正从"可选特性"变为现代大数据处理框架的信任与问责要求，因此需要内置可解释性的调度中间件，为用户提供在截止时间约束下可直接执行的资源调整指导。
AI.method: 1) X-Sched Library：定义调度实体抽象类 XSchedTask（封装 id、状态、类型、初始容器配置、截止时间等），支持从矩阵乘法等简单单点到随机森林、DNN 训练等复杂任务；内置 Broadcast、AllGather、AllReduce、Gather、Reduce、Scatter 六类通信原语，并提供 BSP 与 ASP 两种同步/异步协议版本，以替代与 MPI 后端强耦合、需外部 launcher、缺乏 gRPC/云原生消息层支持的 mpi4py 类方案；与 MLflow 集成（基于 mlflow.pyfunc 与 MLflow 插件）。2) X-Sched Runtime：以"Schedulability Boundary Function" W(x) 为核心——先用回归模型 G_tk(memory, cpu, replicas) 估计任务完成时间 T_tk，再以 t_k^dl − T_tk ≥ 0 判定可调度（Y=1）与否，以 L2 损失为训练目标（式 4–6）。3) 反事实生成：以本地（而非全局）反事实解释为目标，定义动作集 A（如 CPU→+2 cores、instance-num→+2），将解表示为配置元组 {cf1,…,cfq}；用随机森林作为 W，训练时以 bootstrap 子集、随机特征分裂、Gini/熵阈值递归构建树，叶节点标注可调度/不可调度；推理时沿树遍历，在满足邻近性（proximity）、多样性（diversity）、稀疏性（sparsity）、可行性（feasibility）约束且达到目标标签时即早停剪枝返回该节点配置，避免全森林遍历产生过大解集；因树构建天然可并行化且可在无既有配置的情况下工作，搜索效率高。4) 联合损失函数 L(x_tk) = argmin (1/q) Σ ||W(cf_u) − y_cf||_l2，并施加式(4)–(6)三项约束。
AI.result: 1) 可行动作评估：在 4 维配置空间中枚举给定截止时间下的所有可能动作并计算其剩余时间，结果显示生成的反事实解释高度聚集在原实例附近的一个特定区域（灰色球/圈），表明确实满足可行性与邻近性约束，且内存、CPU 核数、副本数对截止时间达成的影响被有效刻画。2) 解密度评估：使用 t-SNE 结合核密度估计（KDE）对解空间降维投影，等高线图显示反事实解在原实例（蓝色星标）周围形成稠密簇，同时向其他区域扩散，验证了多样性与鲁棒性。3) 实验环境为 8 节点本地集群（Intel i7-7820X、128GB RAM、NVIDIA RTX 4090、1Gbps 以太网、Ubuntu 20.04），工作负载来自阿里巴巴生产集群 24 小时长时运行与批处理共置作业轨迹，任务含多实例且上下游实例全部完成后下游才能启动。4) 总体结论：X-Sched 能以极小改动将不可行配置转为可行配置，并在真实执行环境数据上展现出效率、收益与实用性。
AI.conclusion: X-Sched 是一个面向容器化大数据任务的可解释调度中间件，通过反事实解释与随机森林的 Schedulability Boundary Function，将黑盒的资源配置决策转化为用户可直接执行的动作集合，在资源与时间约束下保障 SLO 达成。其价值在于把"可调度性"显式建模为可解释的分类边界，并以邻近性、多样性、稀疏性、可行性四项约束控制建议的质量与可操作性；配套的 X-Sched Library 弥补了现有任务自动化框架在数据/代码/模型制品交换与云原生通信原语上的空白。论文的实验验证主要在可行性解的分布与密度层面，尚缺少与 ILP/SMBO/BO/DRL 等方法的端到端对比以及对反事实解释正确性、运行开销、用户信任度的定量评估，后续可扩展至更广泛的调度决策维度（替代截止时间、执行成本优化）及多任务依赖场景的全局解释。

title: More at Stake: How Payoff and Language Shape LLM Agent Strategies in Cooperation Dilemmas
summary: As LLMs increasingly act as autonomous agents in interactive and multi-agent settings, understanding their strategic behavior is critical for safety, coordination, and AI-driven social and economic systems. We investigate how payoff magnitude and linguistic context shape LLM strategies in repeated social dilemmas, using a payoff-scaled Prisoner's Dilemma to isolate sensitivity to incentive strength. Across models and languages, we observe consistent behavioral patterns, including incentive-sensitive conditional strategies and cross-linguistic divergence. To interpret these dynamics, we train supervised classifiers on canonical repeated-game strategies and apply them to LLM decisions, revealing systematic, model- and language-dependent behavioral intentions, with linguistic framing sometimes matching or exceeding architectural effects. Our results provide a unified framework for auditing LLMs as strategic agents and highlight cooperation biases with direct implications for AI governance and multi-agent system design.

AI.tldr: 本文把“收益矩阵整体乘以正常数”当作一个由定理支撑的**零效应不变性检验**，在完全平衡的 10,000 个 dyad（20,000 个 agent-game、200,000 次决策）网格上检验五个商业 LLM 在重复囚徒困境中的策略行为。结果：五个模型**全部系统性违反尺度不变性**——仅改变数值单位（λ 从 0.01 到 1000）就显著改变合作率（各模型跨尺度范围 0.081–0.636，p_perm ≤ 0.0025），效应方向跨模型相反、跨语言依赖，并在亚单位赌注（λ≤0.1）处反转 persona 提示的作用。核心结论：LLM 的“合作率”不是模型的固定属性，而是**模型 × 提示语言 × persona × 收益表达尺度**的联合属性；单尺度基准不可靠，尺度敏感性应作为标准稳健性指标报告。
AI.motivation: 经典博弈论与决策理论中，将收益矩阵整体乘以正数 λ 是冯·诺依曼–摩根斯坦效用的正仿射变换，不改变偏好排序、最优反应、纳什均衡与复制子动力学轨道；因此对理性行为者的预测效应“恰好为零”。已有 LLM 战略行为研究普遍只在单一收益矩阵下报告一个合作率，把单位选择当作中性实现细节，而非一个可检验的不变性命题；同时语言模型的行为还显著依赖示例顺序、格式、persona 指令与提示语言等“无任务内容”的特征。作者指出：重标度是少见的、理论预期方向与幅度都明确为零的操纵，因此对它的偏离拥有清晰的零假设参照，而非只能与另一个实验条件对比。三个研究问题：(1) 战略行为是否对收益重标度不变、偏离多大；(2) 结果是否依赖提示语言与所分配 persona；(3) 尺度变化只影响合作频率，还是也改变底层策略。
AI.method: 基于 FAIRGAME 框架的无沟通、宣布期限 T=10 的重复囚徒困境（刑责框架，Option A=背叛/Option B=合作，基线 T=0,R=2,P=6,S=10，整矩阵乘以 λ∈{0.01,0.10,0.25,0.5,1,2,5,10,100,1000}，序关系 T<R<P<S 与 2R<T+S 恒保持）。五个模型自配对（Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.4 Nano、Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite、Qwen3 235B-A22B、Grok 4.20），5 种提示语言（英、法、越、中、阿）× 10 尺度 × 4 种有序 persona 配对 × 10 重复 = 10,000 dyads（完整语料含第六模型为 12,000 dyads/240,000 决策），构建脚本内置“完整性守卫”（单元格必须恰 40 dyads 且记录的收益须反推出所属尺度）。统计：整 dyad bootstrap（1,500 次）、尺度标签置换检验（2,000 次，最小 p=0.0005）、按 dyad 聚类的 round-level logistic 回归与九个尺度对比的 Wald χ²₉、type-II 方差分解（模型/语言/尺度及两两交互）、persona 差分（λ≤0.1 vs λ≥0.25 的双重差分）、matched-ladder 与 leave-one-model-out 稳健性。策略读出：四个规范记忆单一规则（AllC/AllD/TFT/WSLS）精确匹配 + 单层 LSTM（仅用合成语料训练，留出准确率 0.985、OOD 10% 噪声 0.936、20% 噪声 0.811），输出 deduced/ambiguous/unmatched 来源与“规则距离”。演化基线：确定性复制子动力学（尺度中性，2,000 随机状态归一化场差 <4×10⁻¹⁴）与有限群体 Fermi 模仿小变异极限（Z=100, β=0.1, ε=0.05，EGTtools 与 mpmath 200 位精度双解算，80 组参数扫描）。
AI.result: 1) 尺度不变性被系统性违反：Claude 范围 0.081 [0.062,0.135]、GPT-5.4 Nano 0.243、Gemini 3.5 0.190、Qwen3 0.095、Grok 0.636（0.274→0.910），全部 p_perm≤0.0025、Wald p<0.001；偏离集中在低赌注端（λ≤1），单位尺度到大尺度无一致方向。2) 聚合掩盖异质性：合并曲线范围 0.154 vs 模型内平均 0.249（衰减 1.62 倍），10 对模型相关中 6 对为负（平均 −0.10）；方差分解显示模型身份 45.4%、模型×尺度 17.9% ≫ 尺度主效应 5.8%；去掉 Grok 后尺度主效应不显著（p=0.33），但 dyad 层面留一法仍显著。3) 语言依赖：同一模型内不同语言的跨尺度范围相差约 2 倍，模型×语言单元从 0.080 到 0.855；多数模型以英语最敏感，但语言与模板措辞混淆（阿语/中文把 penalty 写成“最大化奖励”），故应解读为提示刺激交互而非语言机制；尺度×语言交互在所有模型显著（最大 Holm 校正 p=1.4×10⁻⁴⁸）。4) persona 受尺度调制：λ≤0.1 时五个模型“自私”persona 合作更多（Claude −0.222、Gemini −0.456），Claude/Gemini 出现符号反转，GPT 效应消失，Qwen/Grok 在所有尺度上持续反转 persona（推测与“同伙还是审讯方”的歧义有关）。5) 策略构成随尺度改变：随 λ 上升“恰好匹配单一规范规则”的比例下降（Claude 17.9%→3.5%、Grok 44.6%→17.1%），规则距离上升（仅 Grok 反向）；94.6% 的 TFT 标签、97.1% 的 WSLS 标签来自无规则匹配的轨迹，故只能读作“相似性”而非策略识别。6) 与演化基线方向相反：有限群体中 AllD 份额随 λ 上升（0.267→1.000，80 组设定中 61 组单调），而语料合并 AllD 份额下降（0.436→0.283），即模型随尺度增大变得更合作。7) 机制性分解：自身动作条件（persistence）在所有模型大于伙伴条件（reciprocity），Qwen 的 reciprocity 为负；并指出文献常把 p_CD−p_DC 误当互惠度量（实为 persistence−reciprocity）。8) 公平性：dyad 内 utility gap 与单向剥削存在精确代数恒等式，公平–福利呈 V 形，且对尺度无关联（斜率 0.0004，p=0.85）。
AI.conclusion: 违反尺度不变性意味着形式上“惰性”的单位选择会系统改变 LLM 的战略行为，因此合作率不能被当作模型的尺度无关属性，只能视为模型、提示语言、persona 指令与收益表达尺度的联合属性；混合人机群体模型把“合作倾向”当作固定参数的做法同样受影响。作者强调这只是不变性违反的证据，而非任何特定心理或计算机制的证据——四种解释（提示中不随 λ 缩放的叙事与 persona、亚单位数字的表示/分词、供应商后训练差异、从文本中学到的数量–重要性关联）互不排斥且均可设计针对性实验检验；建议增加“仅按序数描述结果”的语言基线条件。局限：仅五个模型、单一博弈与模板家族、10 轮轨迹（TFT/WSLS 难以与噪声区分，Claude/GPT 的规则距离已达分类器 20% 噪声验证边界）、跨语言差异不能单独归因于语言、演化基线是构造性对照而非证伪。总体建议：在解读单尺度合作基准时保持谨慎，并把尺度敏感性作为 LLM 博弈研究的常规稳健性指标报告；机器战略行为研究不能假定博弈的形式等价会被被提示的智能体自动尊重。

title: Educational Database Prototype: the Simplest of All
summary: Database Management System (DBMS) is designed to help store and process large collections of data, and is incredibly flexible to perform various kinds of optimizations as long as it achieves serializability with a high-level interface available. The current undergraduate level DBMS course in UW-Madison (i.e., CS564) involves implementing specific modules of DB architecture, including B+ tree, but students may end up spending numerous amounts of effort on corner cases and not gaining a more comprehensive understanding of the internal design. Thus, we present EduDB, a simple database prototype for educational purposes that provides students a clean, concise, and comprehensive overview of the database system. We also attempt to develop an integrative series of course projects based on EduDB, which offers a platform for students to perform any optimization learned during the semester.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EduDB——一个面向教学的极简数据库原型（威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校 CS564 课程用），用 C++ 实现，包含解析器、查询执行器、缓冲管理器、文件管理器、并发管理器与事务管理器共六大模块，支持建表、删表、插入、更新、查询、表连接六类 SQL 操作，代码约 1700 行。作者同时设计了以 EduDB 为骨架的一体化课程项目（已实现 join 项目，规划并发控制与索引项目），并配套 GitHub bot + 统一服务器基准测试 + Django/React 排行榜的评测闭环。
AI.motivation: 1) 现有本科 DBMS 课程（UW-Madison CS564）以“实现 B+ 树”等具体模块为主，学生大量精力消耗在边界情形（corner cases）上，反而缺乏对数据库内部设计的整体性理解，且毕业后缺乏解决实际数据库性能问题的底层实践能力。2) 传统讲授式+固定作业的被动学习不利于学生理解“DBMS 没有唯一正确实现”，而建构主义（constructivism）尤其是项目式学习（PBL）在数据库课程中已被证明能提升学生与教师满意度并改善考试表现，其中“覆盖多个模块的一体化项目”被认为是强力的教学手段。3) 现有教学型数据库工具（SimpleDB 超过 7000 行、BadgerDB、SimpleDB(MIT)、tinyDB 等）要么过于庞大难以上手，要么只能在 GUI 上修改、缺乏可编程性。作者借鉴 Sciore 的观点：教师应提供一个“教学编写（pedagogically-written）”且足够简单、留有充分改造空间的数据库源码骨架，让学生修改特定模块，从而既理解整体架构又能自由实现优化。
AI.method: 系统设计：C++ 实现，解析器约 500 行、其余约 1200 行；终端 + socket 的服务器-客户端模式，交互接口仅暴露基础 SQL 事务、尽量减少编码量。六大模块：① Parser——借鉴 Sciore 的 SimpleDB 结构，含 Lexer（keyword/identifier/constant/delimiter 四类，各自带校验函数，匹配失败抛无效查询异常）与递归定义的 Predicate（predicate→term→expression→constant，含布尔组合与语法树），按每种操作预定义“词法单元序列”规则做顺序精确匹配；② Query Executor——数据库“大脑”，按解析结果触发对应 handler 并维护内存元数据（表名集合与各表 schema）；③ Buffer Manager——固定大小缓冲池，每个 buffer 记录页内容、对应数据块 ID 与 pin 计数，pin/unpin 由互斥量保护，满池时用条件变量周期等待（默认 1 秒轮询、10 秒后以“Buffer Manager Abort: not enough space”中止）；④ File Manager——负责具体数据块的读写，每张表一个独立文件，所有字段以二进制定长存储以保证数据大小一致，仅在缓冲未命中时被调用；⑤ Concurrency Manager——锁表含全局锁（系统级，直接实现可串行化）、表级共享锁与排他锁，附锁兼容矩阵，冲突时进入等待队列，由条件变量在锁释放时唤醒，不做死锁检测与预防；⑥ Transaction Manager——每个事务拥有自 0 递增的整数 ID，构造时初始化并发管理器，提交时冲刷并 unpin 全部缓冲、释放所有锁（默认全局锁）。有意省略：查询优化器、恢复管理器与索引结构。执行策略：无内存索引结构，查询时直接全表扫描文件（如 update/select 遍历全部记录并逐条判定谓词）；join 采用简单的嵌套循环连接（Algorithm 1，遍历两表笛卡尔积并按谓词筛选后做投影输出）。教学设计：项目制——学生提交代码到 GitHub 仓库并打标签，bot 自动检测后在统一测试服务器上定期跑基准（可调规模与频率以控制负载干扰），Django+React 实现的排行榜网站展示排名；评分采用自动化测试 + 阈值以下人工复核，反馈格式如“在测试 X 中，提交比嵌套循环连接快/慢 X%”。已落地 join 项目（学生可自由实现 hash join 等），并规划“细粒度并发控制项目（块级锁、wait-die 等死锁预防）”与“索引项目（B 树、哈希表、布隆过滤器，分别支持范围/点查/存在性查询）”。
AI.result: 交付了一个可运行、可串行化的极简数据库原型 EduDB，代码已在 GitHub 开源（yiyins2/Educational-Database-Prototype），并公开了各模块的架构图与伪代码：解析器语法规则示例（如 CREATE TABLE 的 9 步词法序列、UPDATE 语句的词法拆分表）、谓词语法树、查询执行器结构图、缓冲管理器 pin 算法伪代码、文件管理器与锁兼容矩阵等。配套提出了 join 项目及并发管理、索引两个潜在项目方案，以及“GitHub 提交 → bot 检测 → 统一服务器基准测试 → Django/React 排行榜”的通用评测工作流（并给出排行榜 demo 截图）。作者同时坦承当前局限：缺乏系统化大规模测试（目前仅有针对服务器、解析器、并发管理器的小规模简单用例），注释与文档不足，课程项目的说明、测试用例与提示尚未补齐，且 join 操作仍存在尚未修复的问题，系统仍在开发中。
AI.conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是尝试设计并构建“最简单但可执行且可串行化”的数据库系统，为学生提供一个可以实施学期内或课外学到的任意优化的平台，并以 EduDB 为骨架提出一体化课程项目体系与配套基准/排行榜评测机制。作者期望该原型能作为 CS564 未来课程材料的基础。整体属于教学工具型/原型系统型工作：技术新意有限（明确借鉴 Sciore 的 SimpleDB 与经典 DBMS 教科书式模块划分，刻意省略优化器、恢复与索引），其价值更在于教学设计——用“极简骨架 + 改造竞赛”的方式替代繁重的模块实现作业，把学生从边界情形中解放出来，从而获得对数据库内部设计的整体认知与优化实践能力；由于系统仍在开发、缺少系统性评测与完整文档，论文更多定位为课程设计提案与可运行原型展示，尚未提供学习成效的定量验证。

title: Axe: A Simple Unified Layout Abstraction for Machine Learning Compilers
summary: Scaling modern deep learning workloads demands coordinated placement of data and compute across device meshes, memory hierarchies, and heterogeneous accelerators. We present Axe Layout, a hardware-aware abstraction that maps logical tensor coordinates to a multi-axis physical space via named axes. Axe unifies tiling, sharding, replication, and offsets across inter-device distribution and on-device layouts, enabling collective primitives to be expressed consistently from device meshes to threads. Building on Axe, we design a multi-granularity, distribution-aware DSL and compiler that composes thread-local control with collective operators in a single kernel. Experiments show that our unified approach can bring performance close to hand-tuned kernels on across latest GPU devices and multi-device environments and accelerator backends.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TIRx：一个面向 GPU 与 AI 加速器的"原生优先（native-first）"机器学习编译器，通过三个显式接口组织 kernel 编译——(1) 执行域（execution scope：活动线程集合 + team kind，支持 warp/warpgroup/CTA/cluster 及线程过滤与团队切换）；(2) 张量布局（tensor layout：将逻辑索引映射到具名硬件轴的多轴物理空间，含 shard/replica/offset 三段语义，支持非 2 的幂形状与分布式分片）；(3) tile primitive dispatch（基于注册表的确定性分发，按 primitive 类型、后端、存储角色、执行域、配置选择指令族，并用 canonicalize/group/permute/slice 等保布局操作导出合法指令视图）。编译器实现于 TVM/TensorIR 之上。注：所给摘要对应《Axe》一文（仅布局抽象），而正文为 TIRx，可视为把 Axe 的统一布局思想扩展为"布局+执行域+原语分发"的完整编译器。
AI.motivation: 现代 ML kernel 的性能瓶颈愈发依赖编译器抽象，而现有系统的抽象能力与硬件演进脱节，具体挑战有三：(1) 内存层次复杂化——Blackwell 的分布式共享内存 DSMEM、二维张量内存 TMEM，以及加速器的多维片上 scratchpad，要求更结构化、非 2 的幂的存储布局（DeepGEMM 的 128×224 TMEM scale tile 已超出 Triton 线性布局空间）；(2) 线程层次与合作形态多样化——warpgroup、CTA pair、thread-block cluster，以及"逻辑作用域宽于参与线程集"的指令（cluster 级 TMA multicast、tcgen05）；(3) 硬件异构——AI 加速器采用单线程编程模型与需显式分区/布局管理的片上缓冲。既有系统（Triton/Gluon、TileLang、Tilus、CuTeDSL、ThunderKittens、Pallas）各自只覆盖其中一部分，layout 受形状/2 的幂约束、缺少复制语义，cluster 级 TMA multicast 等特性尚不支持，迫使程序员在"等待编译器支持"与"退回原生代码"之间二选一。作者的目标是提供一个既保留 native 级控制与调度能力、又能自动化重复性地址计算/操作数准备/指令循环生成的统一抽象层。
AI.method: **布局系统**：将 NumPy/PyTorch 的 shape–stride 推广为 D(shard, 有序 iter 列表)、R(replica, 集合)、O(offset) 三元组，形式化为 L(x)={D(x)+r+O | r∈R}，即逻辑索引到具名物理坐标的集合值映射；轴名（m、lane、warp、wg、tid_in_wg、cbx/cby、Blackwell 的 Lane/Col、Trainium 的 P/F、分布式 pid）为后端定义且带类型。可表达 2×2 GPU 网格的全分片与"分片+复制"（对应 Alpa 的 S0S1/S0RS）、加速器 2D 分片 SRAM 与 Blackwell TMEM。**执行域**：由"活动线程集合 A"与"团队类型 κ"两个正交分量构成；tfilter 只收缩 A（单轴连续区间或单点谓词），with warpgroup()/thread() 只切换 κ；限制为：过滤只能收缩、条件为单轴连续区间或单点、切换要求各团队内部线程模式一致（否则编译期拒绝）。团队切换把 A 分解为 inter-team（团队实例枚举）与 intra-team（团队内线程模式）两个布局，warpgroup 切换要求 warp 偏移/范围对齐。**Tile primitive 分发**：注册表式确定性策略，dispatch key = {primitive kind, backend, operand storage role, execution scope, config}；先做 canonicalize（消除等价 iter 分解）、group（恢复逻辑秩，如 4D tiled 视图）、permute（仅重排逻辑轴、不改物理放置）、slice（推导子块布局与新偏移）以导出指令兼容视图；随后做合法性校验（dtype、存储角色、对齐、布局、逻辑形状、作用域、描述符/OOB 可表达性），选择最大合法指令形状并发射残余循环（循环融合、描述符外提、偏移化简）。异步族（TMA、cp.async、tcgen05.mma）通过 config 显式暴露 issue/wait/barrier 协议。**可表达性边界**：运行时决定的团队归属/分块所有权（如动态空间划分、work stealing）与位置相关 stride 不在分发契约内，可退回原生层实现；用户可通过切片、config.shape、config 族选择和回退规则四级控制调度。
AI.result: 在 NVIDIA B200（DGX B200，CUDA 13.0）上：FP16 GEMM 相比 cuBLAS 平均差距在 4% 以内（多个 shape 在 2% 内），而 Triton 普遍落后 9–12%；FP8(e8m0) 分块缩放 GEMM 达到 DeepGEMM 的 0.92–0.96×；NVFP4(e2m1) 达到 cuBLASLt 的 0.92–0.97×。FlashAttention-4 前向 MHA（head dim 128）：非因果下比 Triton/Gluon 快 1.16–1.34×（均值 1.23×），与 FlashAttention-4、cuDNN 分别为 1.00×、0.99×；因果下 2K 长度起快 1.07–1.28×（均值 1.18×），约为 FlashAttention-4/cuDNN 的 0.96×，且仅用约 800 行 Python 复现 FA4 优化（TMA copy、TMEM load/store、tcgen05 GEMM、warpgroup 寄存器算子抽象为 tile primitive，指数多项式逼近等细粒度优化在原生层编写）。多 GPU 场景：FP16 GEMM + Reduce-Scatter（sum 原语分发到 multimem.ld_reduce）在所有用例延迟最低，相对最优基线最高加速 1.40×，得益于单 kernel 内通信-计算细粒度重叠。异构后端 AWS Trainium1（trn1.2xlarge）：FP16 GEMM 全面追平手工 NKI 库，MHA 最高 1.44×、均值 1.26× 加速，且代码量从 NKI 的 120/1188 行（GEMM/MHA）降至 78/228 行。代码量对比：FP8 分块缩放 GEMM 相比 DeepGEMM 的 ~550 行 CUDA C++ 降至 ~250 行 Python；FP16 GEMM 用 ~180 行显式指定 1 load warp + 2 GEMM warp + 2 writeback warp 与 size-2 cluster（Triton 基线 ~80 行但仅 2 load/1 GEMM/1 writeback warp 且无 cluster 协作），说明调度/协作配置差异是性能差距来源。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张把编译器抽象的"原料"显式化为三个接口：执行域、张量布局（含 D/R/O 语义）、作用域与布局感知的 tile primitive 分发，并以"原生代码为基底、仅加一层薄库式分发层"的方式保留 peak-performance 所需的精确控制，同时避免因硬件特性演进而修改编译器 pass。与 CuTe 相比，TIRx 用具名轴构造硬件资源词汇表并使前向映射成为集合值（支持复制）；与 Triton 线性布局相比，不受 2 的幂形状限制（以 24×24 列主序映射的 XOR 反例说明不存在 bit-linear f）。相对现有 ML 编译器与分布式框架（Halide/TVM、TileLang/Tilus、Graphene、Pallas、JAX GSPMD/DTensor、Triton Distributed/TileLink），TIRx 在 GPU 内细节与分布式分片语义之间提供了统一表示，且作者认为其技术可被其他编译器/DSL 吸收。局限：布局与调度契约不覆盖运行时动态团队归属与位置相关 stride；峰值性能仍需硬件知识（作用域、对齐、指令形状）。

title: TS-Debate: Multimodal Collaborative Debate for Zero-Shot Time Series Reasoning
comment: Code will be available at https://github.com/DeepAuto-AI/TS-Debate
summary: Recent progress at the intersection of large language models (LLMs) and time series (TS) analysis has revealed both promise and fragility. While LLMs can reason over temporal structure given carefully engineered context, they often struggle with numeric fidelity, modality interference, and principled cross-modal integration. We present TS-Debate, a modality-specialized, collaborative multi-agent debate framework for zero-shot time series reasoning. TS-Debate assigns dedicated expert agents to textual context, visual patterns, and numerical signals, preceded by explicit domain knowledge elicitation, and coordinates their interaction via a structured debate protocol. Reviewer agents evaluate agent claims using a verification-conflict-calibration mechanism, supported by lightweight code execution and numerical lookup for programmatic verification. This architecture preserves modality fidelity, exposes conflicting evidence, and mitigates numeric hallucinations without task-specific fine-tuning. Across 20 tasks spanning three public benchmarks, TS-Debate achieves consistent and significant performance improvements over strong baselines, including standard multimodal debate in which all agents observe all inputs.

AI.tldr: TS-Debate 是一个免训练的推理期多智能体框架，把零样本时间序列推理形式化为"多模态证据仲裁"问题。它先做领域知识引出，再分配文本/视觉/数值三类模态专精分析员进行"协作式辩论"，最后由评审核对通过 VCC（验证-冲突-校准）协议完成可验证声明的编程化核验、跨模态冲突分类与时间范围感知的答案合成。在 3 个公开基准（MTBench、TimerBed、TSQA）共 20 个任务上，分类平均准确率比最强基线提升 25.65%，回归 MAE 平均下降 36.92%，QA 提升 15.06%（分类 p=3.6e-24，QA p=3.4e-8），显著优势在工具对齐对照下依然成立，说明增益来自协议本身而非工具访问；但在局部数值重建类任务（天气点预测、TSQA 插补）上反而不如直接多模态提示，且代价约为单次提示的 3 倍 token、70 秒/样本、$0.033/样本。
AI.motivation: LLM 作为结构化数据的自然语言接口被广泛用于时序推理，但存在三类零样本特有缺陷：(i) 模态干扰——把多模态全部序列化进文本会导致上下文溢出与算术脆弱，而隐式融合又无法区分并选择性信任各模态信号；(ii) 数值脆弱——即便定性模式判断正确，最终答案仍出现算术错误与无根据外推，而经典多智能体辩论（MAD）靠"说服"而非"验证"来解决分歧；(iii) 时间范围模糊——可验证的"过去-现在"断言与不可验证的"未来"断言被混为一谈，导致校准失效。作者因此提出核心问题：需要什么样的推理期协议，才能把"多模态访问"转化为可靠的零样本推理？论文强调贡献不在于单独使用 LLM 智能体、MAD、多模态提示或代码执行（这些均为已有技术），而在于识别并联合解决上述三个零样本 TSR 特有问题。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线（Algorithm 1）。(1) 多模态查询构建：知识引出 k=Elicit(q,c) 生成共享"分析契约"（领域、约束、推荐分析流程、常见陷阱、应关注模态）；从序列导出时域视图、频域视图、特征/统计视图；建立两个显式接口——视觉接口（时域图+频域图）与数值接口 Lookup(·)（区间取值、邻域探测、事件/特征检索、频域信息）。(2) 多模态协作辩论：为模态 m∈{T,V,N} 实例化分析员 A_m，首轮严格模态隔离以最大化认知多样性（e_m^(1)=A_m(q,I_m,k)），第 r≥2 轮条件化于他模态前轮证据迭代修正，但不强制收敛，允许保留有依据的分歧；证据模板严格区分 UNDERSTANDING / OBSERVATIONS / INFERENCES / LIMITS，使可核验观察与解释性推论分离。(3) VCC 协议：从末轮证据抽取原子声明集 Ω，评核员用数值查询、Python 代码执行、图表一致性检查与文本上下文给出 V∈{VERIFIED, UNVERIFIED, CONTRADICTED} 与领域一致性 D∈{MATCHES, VIOLATES, N/A} 双重标注，并从推理质量(0-50)/观察质量(0-30)/诚实性(0-20)三轴评分各分析员；显式冲突建模 Δ∈{NO_CONFLICT, DETECTED, RESOLVED} 及汇总层的答案一致性 Γ 与解决类型 Λ；校准规则为——已验证且无冲突可自信作答，未验证或冲突未决必须保守作答，违反领域约束的声明即使单一模态看似可信也被否决；按时间范围调制：过去-现在任务以对 x_{1:T} 的直接核验为主，未来任务转而评估"成因是否延续"以抑制朴素外推；最终合成器按"方法检查+固定评分量表(5 项 0-20)+决策合成"评估评核员推理质量而非计票，若全体出现方法错误则自行复核关键声明直接推导答案。实验侧：gpt-4.1-mini、temperature=0、2 轮辩论、3 个并行评核员，MTBench/TimerBed/TSQA 共 20 任务、3 次运行、每任务采样 100 例，8 个基线（ZS/CoT/MAD 的 ±MM 变体、ByMyEyes、VL-Time 及带工具对齐变体）。
AI.result: 主结果（Table 2，均值±标准差，3 次运行）：分类平均准确率 TS-Debate 0.534，最强基线 0.425（CoT+MM），提升 25.65%，相对零样本最高提升 80.41%；MTBench 金融 0.543、天气 0.557、TimerBed 0.421、TSQA 0.615 均为最优。回归平均 MAE 10.94，较最优基线 17.34 下降 36.92%，其中 TSQA 预测 MAE 37.35（较最优基线降约 57.7%），MTBench 金融 0.814 为最优；但 MTBench 天气 4.162 逊于 CoT+MM 的 3.523，TSQA 插补 18.343 逊于 Zero-Shot+MM 的 6.729。QA 平均 0.833（较最优基线提升 15.06%，相对零样本最高提升 28.75%），金融 MCQA 0.913、TSQA 判断题 0.897、选择题 0.796 均为最优，开环 QA 0.899 略低于 CoT+MM 的 0.911。显著性：分类 p=3.6e-24(n=2931)、QA p=3.4e-8(n=731)，回归总体不显著；20 个任务中 18 个点估计更优，6 个显著提升，仅在两个局部数值重建任务上显著下降。工具对齐对照（Table 3）：ZS/CoT/MAD+MM+Tools 分类 0.29/0.33/0.39、QA 0.58/0.63/0.67，均低于 TS-Debate 的 0.47/0.83，且 MAD+MM+Tools 用 82.5K token 高于 TS-Debate 的 77.0K，说明增益源于协议而非工具。消融：NVT 三模态组合最优，去掉辩论显著退化；分析师端与评核员端 lookup/代码执行、知识引出均有增益；评核员数与轮次在 2-3 时饱和；去掉视觉通道保留大部分收益（分类 0.373 vs 0.408）且可仅用文本 LLM 运行。冲突分析：5742 条轨迹、28741 次声明裁决中 94.5% 已验证、3.0% 未验证、1.6% 被反驳；冲突标记样本准确率反而更高（0.625 vs 0.536），说明显式核验在解决而非传播分歧。成本：约 70.7 秒/样本、77K token、$0.033/样本；评核员由 3 减至 1 可省约 45% token，轮次超过 2 额外增加 13-35% token 而无稳定收益。
AI.conclusion: 零样本 TSR 的瓶颈不在于模态访问不足，而在于推理期对证据、验证与校准的组织方式。TS-Debate 通过模态隔离的证据生成 + 编程化声明核验 + 显式冲突类型化 + 时间范围感知校准，实现了免训练条件下的一致显著提升，且在工具匹配对照下依然成立；其增益集中在依赖全局结构、跨视图一致性与相对量的任务，而对局部精确数值重建（插补、绝对极值、点预测）反而弱于直接多模态提示，作者的解释是这类任务不存在跨模态分歧可供仲裁。方法定位为高风险、离线、可审计场景的可靠性方案，而非高吞吐服务的通用替代。局限包括：长周期因果推理与高噪声多变量序列上性能可能退化；知识引出目前逐样本进行、数值验证受工具表达力限制；多智能体编排带来显著 token 与时延开销；仅在三个公开基准与单一非推理型骨干（gpt-4.1-mini）上验证，跨更强/推理型骨干及异构骨干分配是否保留增益尚未确证；也未与需训练的 TimeART、TimeOmni-1 等系统比较。未来方向包括可迁移/自适应的知识引出、随分歧模式自适应的辩论拓扑、更丰富的统计检验式验证、结构化检索集成、冲突感知的动态早停与按需分配评核员，以及在 VCC 环内引入值校准的插补/回归先验。

title: Create Benchmarks for Data Lakes
summary:
Data lakes have emerged as a flexible and scalable solution for storing and analyzing large volumes of heterogeneous data, including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured formats. Despite their growing adoption in both industry and academia, there is a lack of standardized and comprehensive benchmarks for evaluating the performance of data lake systems. Existing benchmarks primarily target traditional data warehouses and focus on structured SQL workloads, making them insufficient for capturing the diverse workloads and access patterns typical of data lakes.
  In this work, we propose a new benchmarking framework for data lakes that aims to provide an objective and comparative evaluation of different data lake implementations. Our benchmark covers multiple data types and workload models, including data retrieval, aggregation, querying, and similarity search, which is a common yet underexplored operation in existing benchmarks. We measure key performance metrics such as query execution time, metadata generation time, and metadata size across different scale factors. The benchmark is designed to be extensible and reproducible, enabling users to generate datasets and evaluate data lake systems under realistic and diverse scenarios. We conduct our experiments on CloudLab and demonstrate how the proposed benchmark can be used to compare both commercial and open-source data lake platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向数据湖（Data Lake）的标准化基准测试框架，目标是弥补现有基准（TPC-H/TPC-DS、BigBench、AdBench、DLBench）只覆盖结构化 SQL 工作负载、缺少半结构化/非结构化数据与相似性/关键词检索测试的空白。论文设计了覆盖三类数据格式（CSV / XML / 纯文本日志）、多种工作负载（数据检索、聚合、查询、相似性搜索）、多类指标（查询执行时间、元数据生成时间、元数据大小）的可扩展、可复现基准，并给出数据采集—预处理—查询生成—检索算法（EASE）的完整实现与初步实验。但需注意：摘要声称在 CloudLab 上比较商业与开源数据湖平台，而正文实际是在本地 MacBook 上以 EASE 关键词检索算法的自建测试床（test bed）进行实验，尚未真正部署真实数据湖框架，两者在实验规模与结论范围上存在明显不一致。
AI.motivation: 数据湖已成为存储与分析海量异构（结构化、半结构化、非结构化）数据的灵活可扩展方案，工业与学界采用度快速上升（2020 年市场规模 37.4 亿美元，预计 2026 年达 176 亿美元，CAGR 29.9%），但目前缺乏标准化、综合性的数据湖基准测试体系。现有基准存在三个关键缺口：(1) TPC-H、TPC-DS 等仅面向传统数据仓库，只提供 SQL 工作负载、只测结构化数据，无法覆盖数据湖的多类型数据共存；(2) BigBench 虽加入短文本情感分析，仍缺半结构化支持；(3) AdBench 面向构建在数据湖之上的端到端流水线而非数据湖本身，DLBench 虽自称首个数据湖基准，但仅支持文本+CSV 数据模型且只在作者自研的开源系统 AUDAL 上测试，结果存在偏向性。此外，数据湖中普遍存在的"相似性/关键词查找"操作在现有基准中极少被测试。因此需要一个能客观横向比较不同数据湖实现性能（含商业云厂商与开源实现）的基准套件。
AI.method: 1) 数据集选择：结构化用 IMDb 电影评分 CSV（movie.csv/rating.csv/tags.csv，定义 movieId–userId 评分/打标签关系）；半结构化用 DBLP 2019-04-01 XML 书目数据（论文与作者为节点、作者关系为边）；非结构化用 Apache HTTP 访问日志纯文本（日志正文为节点、按时间戳映射为边）。2) 预处理：将各数据集统一转换为 EASE 算法所需的节点文件（关键词，以空格分隔）与边文件（关系节点索引）。3) 查询生成：对 node.csv 做词频统计得到关键词排名，依据幂律分布丢弃底部 95% 低频词、仅保留 top 5% 以保证 r-半径子图存在；生成单关键词查询集（10 条随机）与多关键词查询集（分"随机连接"与"高连接度节点"两种策略，后者通过在 r-半径邻域内迭代选取高频词实现），用户可自定义单/多词查询数量。4) 测试床：由于时间限制（与 Song 讨论后决定），未部署真实数据湖框架，改为在本地实现 EASE 关键词搜索算法（将各类数据建模为图，构建图索引而非传统倒排索引）作为数据湖模型替身。5) 指标与实验设置：计划测量查询执行时间、元数据生成时间、元数据大小；实际实验在 MacBook Pro（M1 Pro、16GB 内存、512GB 磁盘、macOS Monterey 12.1）上针对 XML 数据集，论文数 2000/4000/8000/16000/32000/64000 逐次翻倍，对比图构建时间、单关键词查询执行时间、多关键词查询执行时间。
AI.result: (1) 图构建时间（即数据湖形成时间）随数据集规模翻倍近似线性增长，说明数据分布均匀且稀疏，新增节点不产生大量新边。(2) 单关键词查询执行时间总体随数据集增大而上升，但增长远慢于数据规模：从 2000 篇时约 0.02 s 增至 32 倍规模（64000 篇）时约 0.2 s，因 EASE 会将图切分为子图并做剪枝，无需访问全部节点，复杂度低于全数据集规模。(3) 存在明显离群点：规模 32000 时查询时间骤增至约 33 s（其他规模均在 1 s 以内），推测因所检索关键词邻居与子图过多（高度连接节点结构导致），作者将其剔除后再分析趋势。(4) 多关键词查询执行时间显著高于单关键词查询，因对子图有更多约束与需要考察更多内容；两者随规模变化的总体趋势相似。(5) 多关键词查询分为 5 词与 10 词两种生成规模。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了一个覆盖结构化/半结构化/非结构化数据、以 EASE 关键词搜索为核心工作负载的数据湖基准原型：包含数据采集脚本（IMDb/DBLP/Apache 日志）、节点-边预处理脚本、基于词频的查询生成脚本，以及可复现的 EASE 实现与度量脚本（查询执行时间、元数据生成时间与大小）。主要发现是：图构建/元数据生成时间随规模近线性增长；查询执行时间随规模上升但因子图剪枝而次线性；多关键词查询开销远大于单关键词查询。作者明确列出局限：查询生成算法需更多样化与个性化（允许用户提供自定义查询）；未能在真实数据湖框架上部署测试（受课程时间限制），未来需在 AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI 等真实实现上运行并与 DLBench/AUDAL 结果对比。需要指出的是，摘要声称的"在 CloudLab 上比较商业与开源数据湖平台"与正文实际完成的本地 EASE 测试床实验不符，且实验中缺少聚合（aggregation）与查询类工作负载的实际执行与元数据尺寸的完整报告，因此当前成果更接近一个可运行的基准原型与初步分析，而非完整的、经真实数据湖验证的基准套件。

title: KUBEDIRECT: Unleashing the Full Power of the Cluster Manager for Serverless Computing
summary:
FaaS platforms rely on cluster managers like Kubernetes for resource management. Kubernetes is popular due to its state-centric APIs that decouple the control plane into modular controllers. However, to scale out a burst of FaaS instances, message passing becomes the primary bottleneck as controllers have to exchange extensive state through the API Server. Existing solutions opt for a clean-slate redesign of cluster managers, but at the expense of compatibility with existing ecosystem and substantial engineering effort.
  We present KUBEDIRECT, a Kubernetes-based cluster manager for FaaS. We find that there exists a common narrow waist across FaaS platform that allows us to achieve both efficiency and external compatibility. Our insight is that the sequential structure of the narrow waist obviates the need for a single source of truth, allowing us to bypass the API Server and perform direct message passing for efficiency. However, our approach introduces a set of ephemeral states across controllers, making it challenging to enforce end-to-end semantics due to the absence of centralized coordination. KUBEDIRECT employs a novel state management scheme that leverages the narrow waist as a hierarchical write-back cache, ensuring consistency and convergence to the desired state. KUBEDIRECT can seamlessly integrate with Kubernetes, adding ~150 LoC per controller. Experiments show that KUBEDIRECT reduces serving latency by 26.7x over Knative, and has similar performance as the state-of-the-art clean-slate platform Dirigent.

AI.tldr: KUBEDIRECT 是一个"改造而非重写"的方案：在 Kubernetes 的"窄腰"（Autoscaler→Deployment→ReplicaSet→Scheduler→Kubelet）控制器链上用 TCP 直连做消息传递以绕过 API Server，并借"分层回写缓存"维持一致性、用 Tombstone 处理不可逆终止。只需每控制器约 150 行 LoC 改动即保持 K8s 生态兼容；相比 Knative 服务延迟降低 26.7×，性能逼近全新设计的 Dirigent。
AI.motivation: FaaS 平台依赖 Kubernetes 这类状态中心（state-centric）的集群管理器，但 K8s 的 write-notify 间接通信使控制器间需经 API Server 交换大量状态（平均 17KB/对象），消息传递成为扩容冷启动的主要瓶颈；实测在 80 节点集群中扩缩数百实例需数十秒，而 Azure Functions trace 中冷启动可达 5 万次/分钟，远超 K8s 控制面能力。已有方案（如 Dirigent）走"全新设计"路线，牺牲了与 K8s 生态（Istio、Prometheus、调度/路由等）的兼容性与巨大工程成本。因此需要一个既能保持 K8s API/生态兼容、又能消除消息传递瓶颈的方案。
AI.method: 核心观察：K8s-based FaaS 平台共享一条"窄腰"控制器链，上游只做离线配置、下游只读，故窄腰是冷启动延迟的主要来源且可独立优化。(1) 绕过 API Server：Autoscaler/Deployment 为 level-triggered 且幂等；Pod 未实例化、可丢弃可重建；窄腰顺序结构保证单写者-单读者，无冲突。(2) 动态物化（dynamic materialization）：拆分动态/静态属性，链路上只传 delta（最小消息格式 KdMessage/KdKey/KdValue，用外部指针引用静态模板），接收端在内存中组装成标准 API 对象以保持透明；借助反射实现松耦合。(3) 分层回写缓存（hierarchical write-back cache）：下游成为事实上的单一真相源，上游机会性地向下游写；下游变更以缓存失效（invalidation）形式回传上游；硬失效通过握手协议（recover/reset 模式，两轮版本号+差异集）实现，软失效走增量消息。(4) 生命周期语义：Pod 终止不可逆，故区分主动终止（幂等，可用 Tombstones 沿链路 CR 式复制）与被动终止；降容为异步、抢占为同步（阻塞等待下游失效信号）；不可达节点通过 API Server 标记 Node 对象失效以排空。(5) 实现：基于 K8s v1.32 + Knative，3.8k 行 Go，每控制器约 150 行改动；exclusive ownership（准入控制保护 replicas 字段）、Endpoints 直推、兼容 HA 主备与滚动部署；并用 TLA+ 验证安全不变式与收敛性。
AI.result: 微基准：Kd 相比 K8s 在 Pod 维度快 3.7–16.9×、函数维度快 7.4–32.8×、替换 Dirigent sandbox manager 后 Kd+ 快 11.9–40.0×；在 4000 节点、2 万 Pod 规模下 30 秒内完成扩容，消息传递额外开销仅约 6%~10%。端到端 FaaS 负载（Azure Functions trace 30 分钟、500 函数、168K 调用）：Kn/Kd 相比 Kn/K8s 的中位（p99）请求 slowdown 改善 3.5×（19.4×），中位（p99）调度延迟改善 26.7×（10.3×）；Dr/Kd+ 相比 Dr/K8s+ 调度延迟改善 6.6×（134×），并与 Dirigent 持平；冷启动次数减少 67%。消融：全量对象直传比动态物化多 20–35% 延迟；单跳软失效 0.5–1.2ms，端到端抢占 6.2–13.4ms，优于 K8s 单次 API 调用的 10–35ms。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别 FaaS 平台共有的窄腰并在其中做最小侵入式改造（每控制器约 150 行 LoC），KUBEDIRECT 证明传统集群管理器无需推倒重来即可兼顾效率与外部生态兼容：直连消息传递消除 API Server 瓶颈，分层回写缓存 + 硬/软失效 + Tombstone 机制在无中心协调下保证一致性与端到端生命周期语义（并经 TLA+ 验证）。其性能已逼近全新设计的 Dirigent，同时保留 K8s API、HA、滚动升级与可观测性；讨论部分指出该方案可推广到其他采用状态中心 API 的集群管理器（Borg、Omega、Twine 等）及自定义控制器。局限：需修改 Scheduler/Kubelet，无法作为纯插件部署；大规模集群下 Kubelet 暴露 Pod 仍会给 API Server 带来压力（约 2 万并发 API 调用），K8s 自身 5000 节点上限依然存在。

title: Topology-Aware Subset Repair via Entropy-Guided Density and Graph Decomposition
summary: Subset repair is an important data cleaning technique that enforces integrity constraints by deleting a minimal number of conflicting tuples, yet multiple minimal repairs often exist. Density-based methods address this ambiguity by favoring repairs that preserve dense, high-quality data regions; however, their effectiveness is limited by density bias from dirty clusters, high computational cost, and uniform attribute weighting. We propose a topology-aware approximate subset repair framework based on a joint density-conflict penalty model. The framework integrates three key components. First, a two-layer conflict detection strategy combines attribute inverted indexes with CFD rule grouping to efficiently identify violations. Second, we introduce EntroCFDensity, a density metric that incorporates information entropy and CFD weights to dynamically adjust attribute importance and reduce homogeneity bias. Third, a conflict degree measure is defined to complement local density, enabling a topology-adaptive penalty mechanism with dynamic weight allocation guided by the coefficient of variation. The conflict graph is further decomposed into independent subgraphs, transforming global repair into tractable local subproblems. Based on this framework, we develop two algorithms: PPIS, a scalable heuristic, and MICO, a mixed-integer programming method with theoretical guarantees. Experimental results show that our approach improves repair accuracy and robustness while effectively preserving high-quality data.

AI.tldr: 基于拓扑感知和联合密度-冲突惩罚模型的近似子集修复框架，通过结合冲突检测、熵加权密度度量和拓扑自适应惩罚，提高数据清洗的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于密度的子集修复方法存在多种最小化修复方案的歧义性，且受限于脏集群引起的密度偏差、高计算成本和均匀属性加权等问题。
AI.method: 提出三层框架：1) 结合属性倒排索引和CFD规则分组的两层冲突检测策略；2) 融合信息熵和CFD权重的EntroCFDensity密度度量；3) 基于冲突度和变异系数的拓扑自适应惩罚机制，并将冲突图分解为独立子图。基于此开发了PPIS启发式算法和MICO混合整数规划方法。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在修复准确性和鲁棒性方面均有提升，并能有效保留高质量数据。
AI.conclusion: 该拓扑感知的近似子集修复框架通过综合考虑密度和冲突惩罚，提供了更准确、高效的数据清洗解决方案，解决了传统密度方法的局限性。

title: Revisiting Parameter Server in LLM Post-Training
summary: Modern data parallel (DP) training favors collective communication over parameter servers (PS) for its simplicity and efficiency under balanced workloads. However, the balanced workload assumption no longer holds in large language model (LLM) post-training due to the high variance in sequence lengths. Under imbalanced workloads, collective communication creates synchronization barriers, leading to under-utilization of devices with smaller workloads. This change in training dynamics calls for a revisit of the PS paradigm for its robustness to such imbalance. We propose \textbf{On-Demand Communication (ODC)}, which adapts PS into Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) by replacing collective all-gather and reduce-scatter with direct point-to-point communication. Compared to FSDP, ODC reduces the synchronization barrier from once per layer to once per minibatch and decouples the workload on each device so that faster workers are not stalled. It also enables simpler and more effective load balancing at the minibatch level. Across diverse LLM post-training tasks, ODC consistently improves device utilization and training throughput, achieving up to a 36\% speedup over standard FSDP. These results demonstrate that ODC is a superior fit for the prevalent imbalanced workloads in LLM post-training. Our implementation of ODC and integration with FSDP is open-sourced at https://github.com/sail-sg/odc.

AI.tldr: ODC是一种针对LLM后训练中计算负载不均衡问题提出的通信优化技术，通过将FSDP的集体通信替换为点对点通信，减少同步障碍并提升设备利用率。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型（LLM）后训练中序列长度的高度差异导致计算负载不均衡，传统数据并行中的集体通信在此场景下会形成同步屏障，使负载较小的设备利用率低下，需要重新评估参数服务器范式对这种不均衡的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出按需通信（ODC），将参数服务器思想融入全分片数据并行（FSDP）框架，用直接的点对点通信替代collective all-gather和reduce-scatter操作，将每层的同步屏障减少为每个小批次的同步，并解耦各设备的工作负载，同时支持更简单有效的小批次级负载均衡。
AI.result: 在多种LLM后训练任务中，ODC持续提升设备利用率和训练吞吐量，相比标准FSDP最高可实现36%的加速。
AI.conclusion: ODC能更好地适应LLM后训练中普遍存在的不均衡工作负载，其实现已开源。

title: NavFormer: IGRF Forecasting in Moving Coordinate Frames
summary: Triad magnetometer components change with sensor attitude even when the IGRF total intensity target stays invariant. NavFormer forecasts this invariant target with rotation invariant scalar features and a Canonical SPD module that stabilizes the spectrum of window level second moments of the triads without sign discontinuities. The module builds a canonical frame from a Gram matrix per window and applies state dependent spectral scaling in the original coordinates. Experiments across five flights show lower error than strong baselines in standard training, few shot training, and zero shot transfer. The code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/NavFormer-Robust-IGRF-Forecasting-for-Autonomous-Navigators-0765

title: Automated structural testing of LLM-based agents: methods, framework, and case studies
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Preprint of an accepted paper at IEEE BigData 2025 (main track). Source code for the introduced methods and framework available at https://github.com/awslabs/generative-ai-toolkit
summary: LLM-based agents are rapidly being adopted across diverse domains. Since they interact with users without supervision, they must be tested extensively. Current testing approaches focus on acceptance-level evaluation from the user's perspective. While intuitive, these tests require manual evaluation, are difficult to automate, do not facilitate root cause analysis, and incur expensive test environments. In this paper, we present methods to enable structural testing of LLM-based agents. Our approach utilizes traces (based on OpenTelemetry) to capture agent trajectories, employs mocking to enforce reproducible LLM behavior, and adds assertions to automate test verification. This enables testing agent components and interactions at a deeper technical level within automated workflows. We demonstrate how structural testing enables the adaptation of software engineering best practices to agents, including the test automation pyramid, regression testing, test-driven development, and multi-language testing. In representative case studies, we demonstrate automated execution and faster root-cause analysis. Collectively, these methods reduce testing costs and improve agent quality through higher coverage, reusability, and earlier defect detection. We provide an open source reference implementation on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出针对LLM智能体的结构化测试方法，包括轨迹追踪、Mocking和断言，实现了自动化、可复用、更早期的问题检测。
AI.motivation: 现有测试方法主要从用户角度进行验收测试，存在需人工评估、难以自动化、不便根因分析、测试环境昂贵等问题。
AI.method: 基于OpenTelemetry的轨迹追踪、Mocking确保LLM行为可重现、断言自动化验证，支持在自动化流程中进行组件级和交互级深度测试。
AI.result: 案例研究表明该方法能实现自动化执行、加快根因分析，降低成本并提高质量，通过更高覆盖率、可复用性和早期缺陷检测。
AI.conclusion: 结构化测试方法使软件工程最佳实践适用于智能体开发，并提供了开源参考实现。

title: Agentic Business Process Management Systems
comment: Presented at the BPM'2025 conference on Artificial Intelligence for Business Process Management (AI4BPM)
summary: Since the early 90s, the evolution of the Business Process Management (BPM) discipline has been punctuated by successive waves of automation technologies. Some of these technologies enable the automation of individual tasks, while others focus on orchestrating the execution of end-to-end processes. The rise of Generative and Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) is opening the way for another such wave. title: Routing End User Queries to Enterprise Databases
summary: We address the task of routing natural language queries in multi-database enterprise environments. We construct realistic benchmarks by extending existing NL-to-SQL datasets. Our study shows that routing becomes increasingly challenging with larger, domain-overlapping DB repositories and ambiguous queries, motivating the need for more structured and robust reasoning-based solutions. By explicitly modelling schema coverage, structural connectivity, and fine-grained semantic alignment, the proposed modular, reasoning-driven reranking strategy consistently outperforms embedding-only and direct LLM-prompting baselines across all the metrics.

title: Modular Foundation Model Inference at the Edge: Network-Aware Microservice Optimization
summary: Foundation models (FMs) unlock unprecedented multimodal and multitask intelligence, yet their cloud-centric deployment precludes real-time responsiveness and compromises user privacy. Meanwhile, monolithic execution at the edge remains infeasible under stringent resource limits and uncertain network dynamics. To bridge this gap, we propose a microservice-based FM inference framework that exploits the intrinsic functional asymmetry between heavyweight core services and agile light services. Our two-tier deployment strategy ensures robust Quality of Service (QoS) under resource contention. Specifically, core services are placed statically via a long-term network-aware integer program with sparsity constraints to form a fault-tolerant backbone. On the other hand, light services are orchestrated dynamically by a low-complexity online controller that integrates effective capacity theory with Lyapunov optimization, providing probabilistic latency guarantees under real-time workload fluctuations. Simulations demonstrate that our framework achieves over 84% average on-time task completion with moderate deployment costs and maintains strong robustness as the system load scales.

title: Latent Structural Similarity Networks for Unsupervised Discovery in Multivariate Time Series
summary: This paper proposes a task-agnostic discovery layer for multivariate time series that constructs a relational hypothesis graph over entities without assuming linearity, stationarity, or a downstream objective. The method learns window-level sequence representations using an unsupervised sequence-to-sequence autoencoder, aggregates these representations into entity-level embeddings, and induces a sparse similarity network by thresholding a latent-space similarity measure. This network is intended as an analyzable abstraction that compresses the pairwise search space and exposes candidate relationships for further investigation, rather than as a model optimized for prediction, trading, or any decision rule. The framework is demonstrated on a challenging real-world dataset of hourly cryptocurrency returns, illustrating how latent similarity induces coherent network structure; a classical econometric relation is also reported as an external diagnostic lens to contextualize discovered edges.

title: Reducing False Positives in Static Bug Detection with LLMs: An Empirical Study in Industry
summary: Static analysis tools (SATs) are widely adopted in both academia and industry for improving software quality, yet their practical use is often hindered by high false positive rates, especially in large-scale enterprise systems. These false alarms demand substantial manual inspection, creating severe inefficiencies in industrial code review. While recent work has demonstrated the potential of large language models (LLMs) for false alarm reduction on open-source benchmarks, their effectiveness in real-world enterprise settings remains unclear. To bridge this gap, we conduct the first comprehensive empirical study of diverse LLM-based false alarm reduction techniques in an industrial context at Tencent, one of the largest IT companies in China. Using data from Tencent's enterprise-customized SAT on its large-scale Advertising and Marketing Services software, we construct a dataset of 433 alarms (328 false positives, 105 true positives) covering three common bug types. Through interviewing developers and analyzing the data, our results highlight the prevalence of false positives, which wastes substantial manual effort (e.g., 10-20 minutes of manual inspection per alarm). Meanwhile, our results show the huge potential of LLMs for reducing false alarms in industrial settings (e.g., hybrid techniques of LLM and static analysis eliminate 94-98% of false positives with high recall). Furthermore, LLM-based techniques are cost-effective, with per-alarm costs as low as 2.1-109.5 seconds and $0.0011-$0.12, representing orders-of-magnitude savings compared to manual review. Finally, our case analysis further identifies key limitations of LLM-based false alarm reduction in industrial settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究在腾讯工业环境中对基于LLM的误报消减技术进行了首次综合实证研究，结果表明混合方法能消除94-98%的误报，同时保持高召回率，每告警成本最低仅2.1-109.5秒和$0.0011-$0.12，比人工审核节省多个数量级。
AI.motivation: 静态分析工具在大型企业系统中存在高误报率问题，导致大量人工检查成本。虽然LLM在开源基准测试中展现了误报消减潜力，但其在真实工业环境中的有效性尚不明确，需要实证验证。

title: LLM Driven Design of Continuous Optimization Problems with Controllable High-level Properties
summary: Benchmarking in continuous black-box optimisation is hindered by the limited structural diversity of existing test suites such as BBOB. We explore whether large language models embedded in an evolutionary loop can be used to design optimisation problems with clearly defined high-level landscape characteristics. Using the LLaMEA framework, we guide an LLM to generate problem code from natural-language descriptions of target properties, including multimodality, separability, basin-size homogeneity, search-space homogeneity and globallocal optima contrast. Inside the loop we score candidates through ELA-based property predictors. We introduce an ELA-space fitness-sharing mechanism that increases population diversity and steers the generator away from redundant landscapes. A complementary basin-of-attraction analysis, statistical testing and visual inspection, verifies that many of the generated functions indeed exhibit the intended structural traits. In addition, a t-SNE embedding shows that they expand the BBOB instance space rather than forming an unrelated cluster. The resulting library provides a broad, interpretable, and reproducible set of benchmark problems for landscape analysis and downstream tasks such as automated algorithm selection.

title: Native LLM and MLLM Inference at Scale on Apple Silicon
summary: The growing adoption of Apple Silicon for machine learning development has created demand for efficient inference solutions that leverage its unique unified memory architecture. However, existing tools either lack native optimization (PyTorch MPS) or focus solely on text models (llama.cpp), leaving multimodal workloads underserved. We present vllm-mlx, a framework for efficient LLM and MLLM inference on Apple Silicon built natively on MLX. For text models, we achieve 21% to 87% higher throughput than llama.cpp across models ranging from Qwen3-0.6B to Nemotron-30B, while providing continuous batching that scales to 4.3x aggregate throughput at 16 concurrent requests. For multimodal models, we introduce content-based prefix caching that eliminates redundant vision encoding by identifying identical images through content hashing, regardless of input format. Our evaluation on Apple M4 Max demonstrates throughput of up to 525 tokens per second on text models and 28x speedup on repeated image queries, reducing multimodal latency from 21.7 seconds to under 1 second. Video analysis with up to 64 frames achieves 24.7x cache speedup. We release our implementation as open source to support efficient inference on consumer Apple hardware.

AI.tldr: vllm-mlx：基于MLX的Apple Silicon原生推理框架，支持LLM和多模态模型，通过连续批处理和内容哈希前缀缓存，相比现有方案实现显著吞吐量提升和延迟降低。
AI.motivation: 苹果芯片在机器学习开发中的普及，需要利用其统一内存架构的高效推理方案。现有工具如PyTorch MPS缺乏原生优化，llama.cpp仅支持文本模型，多模态工作负载缺乏高效支持。
AI.method: 基于MLX原生构建框架，为文本模型提供连续批处理；为多模态模型引入基于内容哈希的视觉前缀缓存，识别相同图像内容以消除冗余编码。

title: Variational Quantum Circuit-Based Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Portfolio Optimization
summary: This paper presents a Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) solution to the dynamic portfolio optimization problem based on Variational Quantum Circuits. The implemented QRL approaches are quantum analogues of the classical neural-network-based Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient and Deep Q-Network algorithms. Through an empirical evaluation on real-world financial data, we show that our quantum agents achieve risk-adjusted performance comparable to, and in some cases exceeding, that of classical Deep RL models with several orders of magnitude more parameters. In addition to improved parameter efficiency, quantum agents exhibit reduced variability across market regimes, indicating robust behaviour under changing conditions. However, while quantum circuit execution is inherently fast at the hardware level, practical deployment on cloud-based quantum systems introduces substantial latency, making end-to-end runtime currently dominated by infrastructural overhead and limiting practical applicability. Taken together, our results suggest that QRL is theoretically competitive with state-of-the-art classical reinforcement learning and may become practically advantageous as deployment overheads diminish. This positions QRL as a promising paradigm for dynamic decision-making in complex, high-dimensional, and non-stationary environments such as financial markets. The complete codebase is released as open source at: https://github.com/VincentGurgul/qrl-dpo-public

title: MulVul: Retrieval-augmented Multi-Agent Code Vulnerability Detection via Cross-Model Prompt Evolution
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to automate real-world vulnerability detection due to two key limitations: the heterogeneity of vulnerability patterns undermines the effectiveness of a single unified model, and manual prompt engineering for massive weakness categories is unscalable.
  To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{MulVul}, a retrieval-augmented multi-agent framework designed for precise and broad-coverage vulnerability detection. MulVul adopts a coarse-to-fine strategy: a \emph{Router} agent first predicts the top-$k$ coarse categories and then forwards the input to specialized \emph{Detector} agents, which identify the exact vulnerability types. Both agents are equipped with retrieval tools to actively source evidence from vulnerability knowledge bases to mitigate hallucinations.
  Crucially, to automate the generation of specialized prompts, we design \emph{Cross-Model Prompt Evolution}, a prompt optimization mechanism where a generator LLM iteratively refines candidate prompts while a distinct executor LLM validates their effectiveness. This decoupling mitigates the self-correction bias inherent in single-model optimization.
  Evaluated on 130 CWE types, MulVul achieves 34.79\% Macro-F1, outperforming the best baseline by 41.5\%. Ablation studies validate cross-model prompt evolution, which boosts performance by 51.6\% over manual prompts by effectively handling diverse vulnerability patterns.

AI.tldr: MulVul是一个检索增强的多智能体框架，采用粗粒度到细粒度的两阶段策略进行漏洞检测。通过交叉模型提示进化技术自动化生成专用提示，有效提升大规模漏洞类型的检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在真实世界漏洞检测面临两大局限：漏洞模式异质性导致单一统一模型效果有限；对海量弱点类别进行手动提示工程不可扩展。
AI.method: 1) 粗粒度到细粒度策略：路由器智能体预测top-k粗粒度类别，转发给专用检测器智能体进行精确漏洞类型识别。2) 检索增强：两个智能体都配备检索工具，从漏洞知识库中主动获取证据以减少幻觉。3) 交叉模型提示进化：生成器LLM迭代优化候选提示，独立执行器LLM验证其有效性，避免单模型优化的自校正偏差。
AI.result: 在130个CWE类型上评估，MulVul达到34.79%的宏平均F1分数，相比最优基线提升41.5%。消融研究验证交叉模型提示进化的有效性，相比手动提示提升51.6%性能，能有效处理多样漏洞模式。

title: Explainable Uncertainty Quantification for Wastewater Treatment Energy Prediction via Interval Type-2 Neuro-Fuzzy System
comment: Submitted to 21st International Conference on Information Processing and Management of Uncertainty in Knowledge-Based Systems (IPMU2026)
summary: Wastewater treatment plants consume 1-3% of global electricity, making accurate energy forecasting critical for operational optimization and sustainability. While machine learning models provide point predictions, they lack explainable uncertainty quantification essential for risk-aware decision-making in safety-critical infrastructure. This study develops an Interval Type-2 Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (IT2-ANFIS) that generates interpretable prediction intervals through fuzzy rule structures. Unlike black-box probabilistic methods, the proposed framework decomposes uncertainty across three levels: feature-level, footprint of uncertainty identify which variables introduce ambiguity, rule-level analysis reveals confidence in local models, and instance-level intervals quantify overall prediction uncertainty. Validated on Melbourne Water's Eastern Treatment Plant dataset, IT2-ANFIS achieves comparable predictive performance to first order ANFIS with substantially reduced variance across training runs, while providing explainable uncertainty estimates that link prediction confidence directly to operational conditions and input variables.

title: Knowledge-Aware Evolution for Streaming Federated Continual Learning with Category Overlap and without Task Identifiers
summary: Federated Continual Learning (FCL) leverages inter-client collaboration to balance new knowledge acquisition and prior knowledge retention in non-stationary data. However, existing batch-based FCL methods lack adaptability to streaming scenarios featuring category overlap between old and new data and absent task identifiers, leading to indistinguishability of old and new knowledge, uncertain task assignments for samples, and knowledge confusion.To address this, we propose streaming federated continual learning setting: per federated learning (FL) round, clients process streaming data with disjoint samples and potentially overlapping categories without task identifiers, necessitating sustained inference capability for all prior categories after each FL round.Next, we introduce FedKACE: 1) an adaptive inference model switching mechanism that enables unidirectional switching from local model to global model to achieve a trade-off between personalization and generalization; 2) a adaptive gradient-balanced replay scheme that reconciles new knowledge learning and old knowledge retention under overlapping-class scenarios; 3) a kernel spectral boundary buffer maintenance that preserves high-information and high-boundary-influence samples to optimize cross-round knowledge retention. Experiments across multiple scenarios and regret analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of FedKACE.

title: VAE with Hyperspherical Coordinates: Improving Anomaly Detection from Hypervolume-Compressed Latent Space
summary: Variational autoencoders (VAE) encode data into lower-dimensional latent vectors before decoding those vectors back to data. Once trained, one can hope to detect out-of-distribution (abnormal) latent vectors, but several issues arise when the latent space is high dimensional. This includes an exponential growth of the hypervolume with the dimension, which severely affects the generative capacity of the VAE. In this paper, we draw insights from high dimensional statistics: in these regimes, the latent vectors of a standard VAE are distributed on the `equators' of a hypersphere, challenging the detection of anomalies. We propose to formulate the latent variables of a VAE using hyperspherical coordinates, which allows compressing the latent vectors towards a given direction on the hypersphere, thereby allowing for a more expressive approximate posterior. We show that this improves both the fully unsupervised and OOD anomaly detection ability of the VAE, achieving the best performance on the datasets we considered, outperforming existing methods. For the unsupervised and OOD modalities, respectively, these are: i) detecting unusual landscape from the Mars Rover camera and unusual Galaxies from ground based imagery (complex, real world datasets); ii) standard benchmarks like Cifar10 and subsets of ImageNet as the in-distribution (ID) class.

Once trained, one can hope to detect out-of-distribution (abnormal) latent vectors, but several issues arise when the latent space is high dimensional. This includes an exponential growth of the hypervolume with the dimension, which severely affects the generative capacity of the VAE. In this paper, we draw insights from high dimensional statistics: in these regimes, the latent vectors of a standard VAE are distributed on the `equators' of a hypersphere, challenging the detection of anomalies. We propose to formulate the latent variables of a VAE using hyperspherical coordinates, which allows compressing the latent vectors towards a given direction on the hypersphere, thereby allowing for a more expressive approximate posterior. We show that this improves both the fully unsupervised and OOD anomaly detection ability of the VAE, achieving the best performance on the datasets we considered, outperforming existing methods. For the unsupervised and OOD modalities, respectively, these are: i) detecting unusual landscape from the Mars Rover camera and unusual Galaxies from ground based imagery (complex, real world datasets); ii) standard benchmarks like Cifar10 and subsets of ImageNet as the in-distribution (ID) class.

title: Towards Safety-Compliant Transformer Architectures for Automotive Systems
summary: Transformer-based architectures have shown remarkable performance in vision and language tasks but pose unique challenges for safety-critical applications. This paper presents a conceptual framework for integrating Transformers into automotive systems from a safety perspective. We outline how multimodal Foundation Models can leverage sensor diversity and redundancy to improve fault tolerance and robustness. Our proposed architecture combines multiple independent modality-specific encoders that fuse their representations into a shared latent space, supporting fail-operational behavior if one modality degrades. We demonstrate how different input modalities could be fused in order to maintain consistent scene understanding. By structurally embedding redundancy and diversity at the representational level, this approach bridges the gap between modern deep learning and established functional safety practices, paving the way for certifiable AI systems in autonomous driving.

title: RIFT: Reordered Instruction Following Testbed To Evaluate Instruction Following in Singular Multistep Prompt Structures
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, submitted to ACL ARR
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly relied upon for complex workflows, yet their ability to maintain flow of instructions remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks conflate task complexity with structural ordering, making it difficult to isolate the impact of prompt topology on performance. We introduce RIFT, Reordered Instruction Following Testbed, to assess instruction following by disentangling structure from content. Using rephrased Jeopardy! question-answer pairs, we test LLMs across two prompt structures: linear prompts, which progress sequentially, and jumping prompts, which preserve identical content but require non-sequential traversal. Across 10,000 evaluations spanning six state-of-the-art open-source LLMs, accuracy dropped by up to 72% under jumping conditions (compared to baseline), revealing a strong dependence on positional continuity. Error analysis shows that approximately 50% of failures stem from instruction-order violations and semantic drift, indicating that current architectures internalize instruction following as a sequential pattern rather than a reasoning skill. These results reveal structural sensitivity as a fundamental limitation in current architectures, with direct implications for applications requiring non-sequential control flow such as workflow automation and multi-agent systems.

AI.method: 作者提出RIFT（Reordered Instruction Following Testbed）测试台，使用重新表述的Jeopardy!问答对，对比线性提示（顺序推进）和跳跃提示（内容相同但需非顺序遍历）两种结构。在包含六个开源SOTA LLM的10,000次评估中测试指令跟随能力。
AI.result: 在跳跃提示条件下，准确率相比基线下降高达72%，显示LLM对位置连续性有强依赖性。约50%失败源于指令顺序违反和语义漂移，表明当前架构将指令跟随内化为顺序模式而非推理技能。

title: IPBC: An Interactive Projection-Based Framework for Human-in-the-Loop Semi-Supervised Clustering of High-Dimensional Data
summary: High-dimensional datasets are increasingly common across scientific and industrial domains, yet they remain difficult to cluster effectively due to the diminishing usefulness of distance metrics and the tendency of clusters to collapse or overlap when projected into lower dimensions. Traditional dimensionality reduction techniques generate static 2D or 3D embeddings that provide limited interpretability and do not offer a mechanism to leverage the analyst's intuition during exploration. To address this gap, we propose Interactive Project-Based Clustering (IPBC), a framework that reframes clustering as an iterative human-guided visual analysis process. IPBC integrates a nonlinear projection module with a feedback loop that allows users to modify the embedding by adjusting viewing angles and supplying simple constraints such as must-link or cannot-link relationships. These constraints reshape the objective of the projection model, gradually pulling semantically related points closer together and pushing unrelated points further apart. As the projection becomes more structured and expressive through user interaction, a conventional clustering algorithm operating on the optimized 2D layout can more reliably identify distinct groups. An additional explainability component then maps each discovered cluster back to the original feature space, producing interpretable rules or feature rankings that highlight what distinguishes each cluster. Experiments on various benchmark datasets show that only a small number of interactive refinement steps can substantially improve cluster quality. Overall, IPBC turns clustering into a collaborative discovery process in which machine representation and human insight reinforce one another.

title: Tricky$^2$: Towards a Benchmark for Evaluating Human and LLM Error Interactions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into software development workflows, yet they often introduce subtle logic or data-misuse errors that differ from human bugs. To study how these two error types interact, we construct Tricky$^2$, a hybrid dataset that augments the existing TrickyBugs corpus of human-written defects with errors injected by both GPT-5 and OpenAI-oss-20b across C++, Python, and Java programs. Our approach uses a taxonomy-guided prompting framework to generate machine-originated bugs while preserving original human defects and program structure. The resulting corpus spans human-only, LLM-only, and human+LLM splits, enabling analysis of mixed-origin error behavior, multi-bug repair robustness, and reliability in hybrid human-machine code. This paper outlines the dataset construction pipeline and illustrates its use through small-scale baseline evaluations of classification, localization, and repair tasks.

title: Neural Theorem Proving for Verification Conditions: A Real-World Benchmark
summary: Theorem proving is fundamental to program verification, where the automated proof of Verification Conditions (VCs) remains a primary bottleneck. Real-world program verification frequently encounters hard VCs that existing Automated Theorem Provers (ATPs) cannot prove, leading to a critical need for extensive manual proofs that burden practical application. While Neural Theorem Proving (NTP) has achieved significant success in mathematical competitions, demonstrating the potential of machine learning approaches to formal reasoning, its application to program verification--particularly VC proving--remains largely unexplored. Despite existing work on annotation synthesis and verification-related theorem proving, no benchmark has specifically targeted this fundamental bottleneck: automated VC proving. This work introduces Neural Theorem Proving for Verification Conditions (NTP4VC), presenting the first real-world multi-language benchmark for this task. From real-world projects such as Linux and Contiki-OS kernel, our benchmark leverages industrial pipelines (Why3 and Frama-C) to generate semantically equivalent test cases across formal languages of Isabelle, Lean, and Rocq. We evaluate large language models (LLMs), both general-purpose and those fine-tuned for theorem proving, on NTP4VC. Results indicate that although LLMs show promise in VC proving, significant challenges remain for program verification, highlighting a large gap and opportunity for future research.

title: CP Loss: Channel-wise Perceptual Loss for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multi-channel time-series data, prevalent across diverse applications, is characterized by significant heterogeneity in its different channels. However, existing forecasting models are typically guided by channel-agnostic loss functions like MSE, which apply a uniform metric across all channels. This often leads to fail to capture channel-specific dynamics such as sharp fluctuations or trend shifts. To address this, we propose a Channel-wise Perceptual Loss (CP Loss). Its core idea is to learn a unique perceptual space for each channel that is adapted to its characteristics, and to compute the loss within this space. Specifically, we first design a learnable channel-wise filter that decomposes the raw signal into disentangled multi-scale representations, which form the basis of our perceptual space. Crucially, the filter is optimized jointly with the main forecasting model, ensuring that the learned perceptual space is explicitly oriented towards the prediction task. Finally, losses are calculated within these perception spaces to optimize the model. Code is available at https://github.com/zyh16143998882/CP_Loss.

title: The Opaque Pointer Design Pattern in Python: Towards a Pythonic PIMPL for Modularity, Encapsulation, and Stability
summary: Python libraries often need to maintain a stable public API even as internal implementations evolve, gain new backends, or depend on heavy optional libraries. In Python, where internal objects are easy to inspect and import, users can come to rely on "reachable internals" that were never intended to be public, making refactoring risky and slowing long-term maintenance. This paper revisits the pointer-to-implementation (PIMPL) idiom from C++ and reinterprets it as a Pythonic pattern of opaque delegation: a small public object (or module) that delegates its behavior to a separate implementation object treated as internal. We situate this pattern within a broader taxonomy of encapsulation techniques in Python, relate it to existing practices such as module-level indirection, facade objects, and backend dispatch, and identify PIMPL-like structures already used in the standard library and the scientific Python ecosystem. We then show how a Pythonic PIMPL can be used in existing codebases to isolate heavy dependencies, support lazy imports, and enable runtime selection of alternative backends without changing the public API. Finally, we discuss the benefits and trade-offs of the approach and offer practical guidance on when the pattern is appropriate and how to apply it in large, long-lived Python libraries.

title: How Much Temporal Modeling is Enough? A Systematic Study of Hybrid CNN-RNN Architectures for Multi-Label ECG Classification
summary: Accurate multi-label classification of electrocardiogram (ECG) signals remains challenging due to the coexistence of multiple cardiac conditions, pronounced class imbalance, and long-range temporal dependencies in multi-lead recordings. Although recent studies increasingly rely on deep and stacked recurrent architectures, the necessity and clinical justification of such architectural complexity have not been rigorously examined. In this work, we perform a systematic comparative evaluation of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) combined with multiple recurrent configurations, including LSTM, GRU, Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM), and their stacked variants, for multi-label ECG classification on the PTB-XL dataset comprising 23 diagnostic categories. The CNN component serves as a morphology-driven baseline, while recurrent layers are progressively integrated to assess their contribution to temporal modeling and generalization performance. Experimental results indicate that a CNN integrated with a single BiLSTM layer achieves the most favorable trade-off between predictive performance and model complexity. This configuration attains superior Hamming loss (0.0338), macro-AUPRC (0.4715), micro-F1 score (0.6979), and subset accuracy (0.5723) compared with deeper recurrent combinations. Although stacked recurrent models occasionally improve recall for specific rare classes, our results provide empirical evidence that increasing recurrent depth yields diminishing returns and may degrade generalization due to reduced precision and overfitting. These findings suggest that architectural alignment with the intrinsic temporal structure of ECG signals, rather than increased recurrent depth, is a key determinant of robust performance and clinically relevant deployment.

title: Dynamic Cogeneration of Bug Reproduction Test in Agentic Program Repair
summary: Bug Reproduction Tests (BRTs) have been used in many agentic Automated Program Repair (APR) systems, primarily for validating promising fixes and aiding fix generation. In practice, when developers submit a patch, they often implement the BRT alongside the fix. Our experience deploying agentic APR reveals that developers similarly desire a BRT within AI-generated patches to increase their confidence. However, canonical APR systems tend to generate BRTs and fixes separately, or focus on producing only the fix in the final patch. In this paper, we study agentic APR in the context of cogeneration, where the APR agent is instructed to generate both a fix and a BRT in the same patch. We evaluate the effectiveness of different cogeneration strategies on 120 human-reported bugs at Google and characterize different cogeneration strategies by their influence on APR agent behavior. We develop and evaluate patch selectors that account for test change information to select patches with plausible fixes (and plausible BRTs). Finally, we analyze the root causes of failed cogeneration trajectories. Importantly, we show that cogeneration allows the APR agent to generate BRTs for at least as many bugs as a dedicated BRT agent, without compromising the generation rate of plausible fixes, thereby reducing engineering effort in maintaining and coordinating separate generation pipelines for fix and BRT at scale.

title: Uncertainty-Aware 3D Emotional Talking Face Synthesis with Emotion Prior Distillation
summary: Emotional Talking Face synthesis is pivotal in multimedia and signal processing, yet existing 3D methods suffer from two critical challenges: poor audio-vision emotion alignment, manifested as difficult audio emotion extraction and inadequate control over emotional micro-expressions; and a one-size-fits-all multi-view fusion strategy that overlooks uncertainty and feature quality differences, undermining rendering quality. We propose UA-3DTalk, Uncertainty-Aware 3D Emotional Talking Face Synthesis with emotion prior distillation, which has three core modules: the Prior Extraction module disentangles audio into content-synchronized features for alignment and person-specific complementary features for individualization; the Emotion Distillation module introduces a multi-modal attention-weighted fusion mechanism and 4D Gaussian encoding with multi-resolution code-books, enabling fine-grained audio emotion extraction and precise control of emotional micro-expressions; the Uncertainty-based Deformation deploys uncertainty blocks to estimate view-specific aleatoric (input noise) and epistemic (model parameters) uncertainty, realizing adaptive multi-view fusion and incorporating a multi-head decoder for Gaussian primitive optimization to mitigate the limitations of uniform-weight fusion. Extensive experiments on regular and emotional datasets show UA-3DTalk outperforms state-of-the-art methods like DEGSTalk and EDTalk by 5.2% in E-FID for emotion alignment, 3.1% in SyncC for lip synchronization, and 0.015 in LPIPS for rendering quality. Project page: https://mrask999.github.io/UA-3DTalk

title: The Geometric Reasoner: Manifold-Informed Latent Foresight Search for Long-Context Reasoning
summary: Scaling test-time compute enhances long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, yet existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off between computational cost and coverage quality: either incurring high training expense or yielding redundant trajectories. We introduce The Geometric Reasoner (TGR), a training-free framework that performs manifold-informed latent foresight search under strict memory bounds. At each chunk boundary, TGR scores candidate latent anchors via a lightweight look-ahead estimate combined with soft geometric regularizers that encourage smooth trajectories and diverse exploration. Chunk-wise KV cache resets keep memory linear in chunk length. On challenging math and code benchmarks, TGR improves robust trajectory coverage, measured by the area under the Pass@$k$ curve (AUC), by up to 13 points on Qwen3-8B, with negligible overhead of about 1.1--1.3 times.

title: HalluJudge: A Reference-Free Hallucination Detection for Context Misalignment in Code Review Automation
summary: Large Language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in code review automation, such as review comment generation, yet they suffer from hallucinations -- where the generated review comments are ungrounded in the actual code -- poses a significant challenge to the adoption of LLMs in code review workflows. To address this, we explore effective and scalable methods for a hallucination detection in LLM-generated code review comments without the reference. In this work, we design HalluJudge that aims to assess the grounding of generated review comments based on the context alignment. HalluJudge includes four key strategies ranging from direct assessment to structured multi-branch reasoning (e.g., Tree-of-Thoughts). We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of these assessment strategies across Atlassian's enterprise-scale software projects to examine the effectiveness and cost-efficiency of HalluJudge. Furthermore, we analyze the alignment between HalluJudge's judgment and developer preference of the actual LLM-generated code review comments in the real-world production. Our results show that the hallucination assessment in HalluJudge is cost-effective with an F1 score of 0.85 and an average cost of $0.009. On average, 67% of the HalluJudge assessments are aligned with the developer preference of the actual LLM-generated review comments in the online production. Our results suggest that HalluJudge can serve as a practical safeguard to reduce developers' exposure to hallucinated comments, fostering trust in AI-assisted code reviews.

AI.result: HalluJudge在幻觉检测上成本效益高，F1分数达0.85，平均成本仅$0.009。平均67%的HalluJudge评估与在线生产环境中开发者对实际LLM生成评论的偏好相一致。

title: Exploring Weaknesses in Function Call Models via Reinforcement Learning: An Adversarial Data Augmentation Approach
summary: Function call capabilities have become crucial for Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling them to interact more effectively with external tools and APIs. Existing methods for improving the function call capabilities of LLMs rely on data obtained either through manual annotation or automated generation by models, and use this data to finetune the LLMs. However, these methods often lack targeted design and are constrained by fixed patterns and data distributions, which limits their effectiveness in enhancing the generalization and robustness of function call LLMs. To address this limitation, we propose a novel adversarial data augmentation method that employs reinforcement learning to systematically identify and target the weaknesses of function call LLMs. Our training framework introduces a query model trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to generate adversarial queries that are specifically designed to challenge function call (FC) models. This approach adopts a zero sum game formulation, where the query model and the FC model engage in iterative alternating training. Overall, our method advances the development of more robust FC models and provides a systematic way to identify and correct weaknesses in the ability of LLMs to interact with external tools.
